The '''Najiba Loop''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that bypassed [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] by going past [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]].<ref name="TEA" />
